BrochureContent.Content:
Set within the charming and historic Hibernian Buildings on Albert Road, No. 2 is a delightful two-bedroom terraced home that offers a rare blend of period character and contemporary living. Originally constructed in 1877 as part of a collection of artisan dwellings, Hibernian Buildings is recognised as an important part of Cork’s architectural and social history. The terrace is particularly distinctive, retaining much of the character of this historic streetscape, while this individual property was fully renovated in 2017 to create a comfortable and modern home. The property appeals to a range of purchasers from first time buyers/ downsizers and investors. Viewing is highly recommended 

The location is equally appealing. Albert Road sits within Cork’s South Docks and Ballintemple area, close to the city centre while retaining a strong sense of neighbourhood. The surrounding area has undergone significant regeneration in recent years, bringing a vibrant mix of residential, commercial and leisure amenities to the wider Docklands. The property is also surrounded by an interesting collection of historic buildings and former railway and industrial sites, giving this part of Cork a distinctive character that is difficult to replicate elsewhere.
